title: Sun Spots vs Melasma: How to Tell and Treat
h1: Sun spots or melasma? How to tell, and why the treatment is different
desc: Sun spots vs melasma: how they look, what causes them, why laser works well on one and can worsen the other, and treatment options in Dubai.
answer: Sun spots (lentigines) are well-defined brown spots caused by UV exposure, and they usually clear well with laser pigment removal (AED 600 + VAT at Skin & Laser). Melasma is patchy, symmetrical brown pigment on the cheeks, forehead or upper lip, driven by hormones, heat and sun; it needs a gentler combined plan because aggressive laser can make it worse.
body:
## Why it matters in Dubai

Year-round sun and heat make both common here. Heat alone can darken melasma, so even indoor heat and hot yoga can play a part.

## Treating sun spots

Q-switched Nd:YAG or pico laser breaks up the pigment, which darkens and flakes off within 7 to 10 days. One to three sessions usually clear a spot.

## Treating melasma

- Strict daily SPF 50 and a hat
- Prescription or professional brightening skincare
- Chemical peels such as the Miami peel
- Salmon DNA and gentle low-energy laser in some cases
- Dr Khan's Glow Like Never Before + package combines these
faq: Yes, it's common. Your doctor will plan each separately.
It can be controlled well, but it tends to recur, so maintenance and sun protection matter.
Only gentle settings as part of a plan. Aggressive laser can darken it.
